description.value: Hillpoint Estate Farm Stand is a working estate farm in the Cowichan Valley near Duncan, operating as both a farm stand and a farmers market. The property also functions as a wedding venue, reflecting the broader agri-tourism character of this part of Vancouver Island. Its active social media presence documents day-to-day farm life, from haying to seasonal produce.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The primary evidence source is the Facebook page, which confirms the OSM address (4265 Hillbank Rd, Duncan, BC V9L6L8) and email. Recent posts (4 days and 21 hours ago) confirm the business is actively operating. No amenity details (bike parking, water, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those fields are null; Basic groceries is marked true based on the business's own Facebook category labels ('Farm', 'Farmers Market') and OSM shop=farm tag, consistent with the 'Farm Stand' name.
concerns: OSM name is 'Hillpoint Estate Farm Stand' but the Facebook page header lists the business simply as 'Hillpoint Estate Farm' (no 'Stand').

The URL in the OSM record was auto-discovered as a Facebook page; the business's own website (http://www.hillpointfarm.com/) was found within the Facebook profile and used as the primary website here — OSM has no native website tag to confirm against.
No phone number found in OSM tags or website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively posting farm stand in the Cowichan Valley; a legitimate stop for touring cyclists seeking local farm produce on rural routes near Duncan.

wow_evidence: working estate farm in the Cowichan Valley… farm stand and a farmers market
